smithy.name: Blacksmith
smithy.description: The forge is warm even before dawn. Your father works here, a few steps from the market.

market.name: Market
market.description: Traders fill the little market lane. Prices depend on patience and the seller’s opinion of you.

square.name: Town Square
square.description: Briarwick’s meeting place for notices and village affairs.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: Meals, dishwashing shifts, and the firewood pile keep this tavern busy.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: A modest watch post that will matter when war reaches Briarwick.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.description: A quiet place on the northern rise.

gate.name: South Gate
gate.description: The road beyond town leads into a much larger world.

northGate.name: North Gate
northGate.description: The pass climbs toward the mountains.

eastGate.name: East Gate
eastGate.description: A wooden bridge crosses the river just beyond the eastern gate.

westGate.name: West Gate
westGate.description: The western road disappears into the forest.

objectives.errand: Go to the market for iron stock.
objectives.robbed: Earn enough coin, then buy iron stock.
objectives.materials: Return to the smithy and forge your dagger.
objectives.sleep: Sleep at the smithy. Tomorrow is your birthday.
objectives.drafted: The draft has come to Briarwick.
objectives.fatherCall: Father wants to speak with you at the forge.
objectives.fatherTalk: Listen to Father in the forge.

sidebar.timeHelp: Walking and work move the clock forward. Sleep removes fatigue; wounds heal only a little.
sidebar.objectiveHint: Follow the marked locations on the town map.
sidebar.draftedHint: The opening chapter ends here. Briarwick remains open for exploring.
sidebar.stayAwakeRule: after 16 hours, your stamina cap begins to fall. At 48 hours awake it reaches half.
sidebar.getHurtRule: wounds lower available stamina further. Sleep clears fatigue and heals 12 health; injuries still carry over.
sidebar.opensLater: This location opens in a later chapter.
sidebar.howToPlay1: Hover or click a location icon to expand its actions. Hover or click Work to see jobs. Walking, jobs, trade, and forging all happen inside the map window.
sidebar.howToPlay2a: In the forge, use the door or
sidebar.tutorialHint: Follow the glowing blacksmith marker on the town map.
sidebar.fatherTalkHint: Father is speaking to you in the forge.
sidebar.returnForgeHint: Return to the forge to finish speaking with Father.
sidebar.routeLockedHint: The market remains closed for now. You can return to the forge.

map.townDescription: A small market town with room to become something greater.
map.forgeDescription: A working forge, coal store, and two small rooms under one roof.
map.townAria: Illustrated map of Briarwick, a small town with market, blacksmith, tavern, and town square
map.forgeAria: Top-down floor plan of the blacksmith house with a forge, warehouse, father’s room, and son’s room
map.doorHint: Choose a room or workstation on the house map
map.growthTitle: From a small town to a capital
map.growthDescription: Future chapters can add districts, walls, civic projects, and your own seat of rule.
map.footerDescription: Map, travel, and survival rules are playable. Combat and detailed mini games come next.
map.rerouteHint: Choose Walk at another unlocked location to change course.

modal.objectiveHint: Use the location icons to choose where to go next. Time passes whenever you travel or work.
modal.pawnHelp: Sleep need grows while awake. Fatigue begins lowering stamina after 16 hours; injury lowers it further.
modal.restartHelp: This resets the local prototype to the first morning in Briarwick.
modal.injury: Your health is {health}/100. Injury has lowered your starting stamina to {stamina}/100.
modal.lockedHelp: This location will open in a later chapter.
modal.lockedFuture: This location is part of Briarwick’s future. It will open in a later chapter.
modal.alreadyBought: You already bought the iron stock. Take it to the forge.
modal.sellerAsks: The seller asks {price} coins. His mood is {mood}.
modal.fatherAsked: Father asked you to bring back iron stock.
modal.woodHelp: The log turns and drifts by itself. Strike when a split mark lines up with the fixed axe and the log is centered. For unmarked pieces, aim through the middle.
modal.dishesHelp: A one-hour placeholder work shift earns 3 coins. The washing mini game will be added later.
modal.forgeNeed: Father is waiting for the iron stock from the market.
modal.forgeDone: Your dagger is ready. Father wants you to sleep before tomorrow.
modal.forgeHelp: Father guides you through a two-hour forging session. Detailed blacksmithing will be built in a later pass.
modal.sleepHelp: Sleep need: {need}%. Rest clears fatigue and heals 12 health. Injuries still carry over.
modal.sleepAway: Return to the blacksmith shop to sleep.
modal.workbenchHelp: Tools, iron stock, and your future craft projects will live here. The dagger begins at the forge.
modal.tutorialObjectiveHint: Follow the glowing blacksmith marker and choose the house icon to enter.
modal.routeLockedHint: Father’s errand is noted. The market is still closed.

events.start: Father needs iron stock from the market. It is a short walk from the forge.
events.startJournal: Father sent you to the market for iron stock.
events.bandits: Bandits stop you on the road to the market. You fight, lose your coin, and are left wounded. Combat will be built in the next phase.
events.travel: You walk to the {place}. The journey takes {duration} minutes.
events.wood: You split {pieces} pieces of firewood with an average cut quality of {quality}% and earn {coins} coins.
events.dishes: You wash dishes for an hour and earn 3 coins. The washing mini game is planned for a later pass.
events.refuse: The merchant has had enough of your offers and refuses to sell to you today.
events.insult: The merchant calls that offer insulting. His opinion of you worsens, and future asking prices rise.
events.needCoins: You need {price} coins for that offer. Earn more before returning.
events.accepted: The merchant accepts {price} coins. You have the iron stock your father requested.
events.needTip: You need a coin to tip the merchant.
events.refuseTip: The merchant refuses your tip today. Try again after a night of rest.
events.tipped: You leave a coin for the merchant. He remembers the gesture.
events.forged: Under your father’s guidance, you forge your first dagger. The deeper forging game will come later. He sends you to bed.
events.draft: Your sixteenth birthday begins. Father says he has a surprise for you—but the town bell rings before he can explain. Every man aged sixteen or older has been called to the army.
events.rested: You sleep until morning. Fatigue clears; your wounds improve a little, but remain.
events.migratedRobbed: Bandits took your coin on the road to the market, leaving you wounded.
events.migratedMaterials: You bought the iron stock your father requested.
events.intro: A quiet morning begins at your father’s house.
events.fatherCall: Father calls you over. He wants to speak with you in the forge.
events.fatherTalk: Father is waiting by the anvil with an errand for you.
events.roadTraveler: A passing traveler gives you a nod as you continue along the road.
events.tavernWork: The innkeeper offers you work splitting logs or washing dishes.

forgeHouse.loadingCoal: Adding coal to the furnace… about 3 seconds.
forgeHouse.furnaceHelp: Click the furnace to load one coal. Each load takes 3 seconds.
forgeHouse.furnaceFull: The furnace is full for now.
forgeHouse.noCoal: The warehouse has no coal left.

details.anvil: This is where your father shapes hot metal. Your dagger lesson begins here.
details.water: The water barrel is ready for quenching. A detailed quenching step will come with the smithing game.
details.oil: There is room for an oil barrel here. Oil quenching can be unlocked later.
details.workbench: Tools and future craft projects belong at this bench.
details.warehouse: Fuel, iron stock, and spare tools are kept here.
details.fatherBed: Your father keeps his own sleeping room beside the warehouse.
details.sonBed: Your small room is ready when you need to sleep.
details.door: This door opens onto the lane near Briarwick’s market.

tutorial.callMessage: Father wants to talk to you about something. Go inside the blacksmith’s forge.
tutorial.chooseEnter: Now choose the house icon to enter the forge.
tutorial.fatherMessage: Good morning, son. I need iron stock from the market. Bring it back and I will show you something at the anvil.
tutorial.lockedPlace: This location is not available yet.

father_met.description: Father is waiting in the forge. Open the blacksmith marker and go inside.

iron_errand_accepted.description: Father has an errand for you. Hear him out and accept it.

bandit_ambush_survived.description: Head from the forge toward the market for iron stock.
bandit_ambush_survived.travel: Take the road to the market

iron_stock_bought.description: The bandits took your coin. Earn more, then bargain for iron stock.
iron_stock_bought.buy: Buy iron stock at the market

dagger_forged.description: Bring the iron to Father and make your first dagger.
dagger_forged.forge: Return to the forge and shape the dagger

drafted.description: Father wants you to sleep. Tomorrow is your sixteenth birthday.
drafted.sleep: Sleep in your room at the smithy

tavern_work_offered.title: Find work at the tavern
tavern_work_offered.description: The Copper Cup might have odd jobs that can replace your lost coin.
tavern_work_offered.speak: Walk to the tavern and speak with the innkeeper.

mapEditor.title: Town map editor
mapEditor.buildingHelp: Drag over 2 to 4 cells in each direction to place a building. Click for 2×2. Set its entrance on a neighboring road.
mapEditor.paintHelp: Click or drag across cells to paint. Choose a detail or entrance to place it on one cell.
mapEditor.gateHelp: Click for a one-cell gate, or drag across cells to make a wider gate.
mapEditor.gatePlaced: Gate placed. Connect it to the road network before saving.
mapEditor.clearBuilding: Clear or move the building first.
mapEditor.doorRoad: Select a road cell for the entrance.
mapEditor.doorBuilding: No building touches that road cell.
mapEditor.occupied: Those cells are occupied by a road, wall, terrain feature, or another building.
mapEditor.buildingPlaced: Building placed. Add a neighboring road if its entrance needs one.
mapEditor.resetDone: Draft restored from the saved map.
mapEditor.saveFailed: Could not save the map to the project. Download the JSON instead.
mapEditor.fixErrors: Fix the map issues before saving.
mapEditor.gateImageHelp: Each gate can use its own image path.

tavern.greeting: Welcome to the Copper Cup. You look like you need coin more than ale. What brings you here, lad?

answer.bandits: Bandits took the money Father gave me.
answer.father: I need to buy iron for my father’s forge.
answer.work: I am looking for honest work.

reply.bandits: Road thieves again? I am sorry, lad. The woodpile needs splitting, and there are dishes in the kitchen. Do either job well and I will pay you.
reply.father: Your father has helped this tavern often enough. Split firewood for the hearth or wash up in the kitchen, and you can earn your iron money.
reply.work: Good. I can use steady hands. The woodpile pays better if you split cleanly; the dishes are easier but pay less.

woodcut.illustration: A log turning and shifting beneath a fixed axe line
woodcut.choosePiece: Choose a piece on the block or lift one that fell.

landing.1: One piece stayed on the block.
landing.2: Both pieces stayed on the block.

woodcut.finished: {pieces} pieces ready. The innkeeper offers {coins} coins.
woodcut.timingHint: Watch the moving log. Press the axe button at the right moment.
